moments.author: Kevin Warsh
moments.quote: Inflation is still too high—if underlying trends don’t improve, interest rate hikes are in play.
moments.why: Men 25–45 tracking markets are buzzing—Fed chair's hawkish Jackson Hole tone signals more borrowing pain ahead.

moments.author: Lionel Messi
moments.quote: Scored four goals and added an assist in Inter Miami’s record 7‑1 win over Montreal.
moments.why: A jaw‑dropping performance from a 39‑year‑old superstar—guys everywhere are calling it vintage Messi.

moments.author: Messi
moments.quote: Became just the 19th player in MLS history to score four goals in a game and reached 20 multigoal games fastest.
moments.why: Stat nerds and sports bros note the history—speed records, club highs, multigoal milestones.

moments.author: Guillermo Hoyos
moments.quote: Words simply fall short to describe such footballing beauty.
moments.why: Coach’s poetic praise of Messi’s display adds emotional weight to the legendary performance.
